verdict.rationale: Dagster orchestrates data pipelines and has integrations for dbt, Airbyte, Fivetran, dlt, etc., but there is no evidence of any built-in or documented capability to load data into vector stores or LLM-ready formats (e.g., embeddings, chunking, vector DB connectors) for agent retrieval. The evidence pack covers general orchestration, automation, and AI-agent-assist tooling (MCP server, AI skill for coding agents) but nothing about vector store integration or LLM-ready output formats.
